name: Sample Mod (developer)
description: EMF's developer test mod. With the write tests on, keys you set move the time of day, spawn and destroy, call a villager and give an item; no key by default. Not for players.

settings.label: Allow the write tests (the test keys below)
Test key: time of day +3 h
settings.help: Empty = no key (the default, so test keys never take a key a mod uses).

settings.label: Test key: spawn the first template
Test key: spawn the second template
Test key: destroy the last spawn
Test key: nearest villager comes to you
GUID byte layout
settings.help: ms = the Windows layout the game uses; raw = bytes in text order.
